title: University of Pennsylvania — College Green outdoor vignette
assetProvenance: Original procedural geometry. Reference photographs and maps are consulted for architectural language and campus adjacencies only, and are not bundled as textures or models.
coordinateSystem: Independent local metres; x east, y up, z south. Outdoor ground datum 0. College Green is central; College Hall to the south, Fisher and Meyerson to the east, Van Pelt to the north, Locust Walk/36th Street Walk to the west.
scope: 303 by 250 metre hand-modelled outdoor vignette. Footprints, heights and decorative profiles are approximate, not surveyed. Exterior restoration scaffolding, interiors, current opening hours and access restrictions are not simulated.

sources.publisher: University of Pennsylvania Facilities and Real Estate Services
sources.supports: College Green's cardinal boundaries: College Hall south, Fisher and Meyerson east, Van Pelt north, 36th Street Walk west.
Campus pedestrian relationships and relative positions; consulted as the official self-guided campus map, not a measured floor plan.

sources.publisher: University of Pennsylvania Facilities and Real Estate Services
sources.supports: College Hall: Thomas W. Richards, green serpentine stone, polychromatic Victorian Gothic details.

sources.publisher: University of Pennsylvania Facilities and Real Estate Services
sources.supports: College Hall identity and exterior campus context.
College Hall's original tall west and east towers were removed in 1914 and 1929. The model intentionally does not reconstruct those former towers.
Modern north facade reference: long green stone elevation, contrasting brown window surrounds, pointed openings, central gable and slate roof.

sources.publisher: University of Pennsylvania Facilities and Real Estate Services
sources.supports: Fisher Fine Arts Library at 220 South 34th Street, designed by Furness Evans Co.; main entrance faces College Green and has stone stairs. Sources record additions, restoration and 2025–26 envelope work; this vignette shows the architectural exterior without temporary scaffolding.
Fisher semi-circular arches with short stone columns, brick, terra cotta and stone material vocabulary, and Victorian Romanesque details.

sources.publisher: Penn Weitzman School of Design Architectural Archives
sources.supports: Furness original library design and building history; model is newly authored and does not redistribute architectural archival drawings.
Fisher exterior photograph: red masonry, tall arched glazing, layered roof silhouette and round crenellated turret.

sources.publisher: University of Pennsylvania Facilities and Real Estate Services
sources.supports: College Green landscape language: canopy trees, lawns, brick and stone paving, granite curbs and consistent site furniture.

modelAssumptions.collegeHall: 112m long simplified main mass, 18.8m eaves and a central gable about 33m high; projecting end bays, current gables without historic tall towers, thick window surrounds and cornices. Dimensions estimated for the playable vignette.
modelAssumptions.fisher: 38m by 56m main reading-room mass, 23.7m eaves, layered high roof with copper lantern, a north-west round turret and projecting west entrance. Dimension estimates and some repetitive ornamental profiles are stylized.
modelAssumptions.context: Van Pelt Library, Meyerson Hall and Cohen Hall are simplified surrounding masses; no interiors or real-time campus services are represented.
modelAssumptions.landscape: Lawn plots and 18 tree positions are authored for clear exploration routes. Benches and lanterns have collision, trees are instantiated by the shared scene vegetation system.
